justifications.r1: Eminence reduces all dragon costs by {1} all game; optimized fetch/shock ramp lands and rocks.
justifications.r2: Elemental Bond, Garruk's Uprising, The Great Henge, and Dragon draw engines.
justifications.a1: Dragon tutors (Sarkhan's Triumph, Scion of the Ur-Dragon) and dragon redundancy.
justifications.a2: Deploys 5-6 CMC dragons ahead of curve on Turns 4–5.
justifications.p1: Presents lethal flying dragon combat pressure on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps to eliminate pod through combat.
justifications.p3: Big flying threats clearly visible on board.
justifications.i1: Terror of the Peaks ETB burn, Dragon Tempest, and flexible spot removal.
justifications.i2: Light incidental ETB burn clearing opposing boards.
justifications.s1: Heroic Intervention, Lightning Greaves, and dragon ward effects.
justifications.s2: High mana availability enables easy redeployment of dragons post-wipe.
justifications.s3: Eminence functions continuously from the command zone; Ur-Dragon rarely even needs to be cast.
